title: Mixed Event — A Bright Future!!

meta.Outline: Bit by bit, the members of Leo/need continue preparations for their first show together. Their new song is coming along well, and all that's left is for Ichika to add her lyrics. She's determined to express the feelings that Saki put into the composition, but will it be so easy...?

rows.Line: School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay, I think we're set with this song...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yay!
Finally, we played it without missing a note!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Great work, girls.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thanks, Miku!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It's like the pieces for this song just started falling into place once we worked out each individual part.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I can't wait to see you all perform.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I can't wait to play it either!
The very first, completely original Leo/need song♪

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I feel the same way...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Our very first original song.
It carries so much more weight when you put it that way.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Saki, Shiho, thank you both.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Saki's the one who actually wrote it. I didn't do anything by comparison.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That's not true at all.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Sure, Saki came up with the overarching melody, but we wouldn't have known how to put the rest together.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Exactly. We would've kept wandering in the dark if it weren't for you, Shiho.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So, Shiho, thank you so much...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You're welcome...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Anyway, we'll start practicing this song in full tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: In the meantime, we'll throw in some placeholder lyrics while Ichika works on the actual words. Then, we'll need to see how her lyrics fit into the song.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Grrr...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Is something the matter, Rin?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Sort of...
Is he really just gonna keep hiding like this...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Don't mind her.
It's just something we're dealing with right now.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Still, I can't wait to see what you've come up with, Ichika.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah!
I'm so excited to see what kind of lyrics you wrote♪
The next day
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 1-C

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: A slight tone of uncertainty or a sense of doubt might make it sound better during the chorus...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: A song that's just for us...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I do think that it'd be really great to make music that touches people's hearts like Shiho says...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But I realized something while I was writing this song!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It finally hit me that it's probably gonna be more challenging that we could ever imagine!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Especially considering how difficult it is to compose music from scratch.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hey, I warned all of you.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I know, but...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But then I realized something else!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: As hard as it was to write this song, we might have to make even tougher decisions along the way while we try to go pro!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That's why I wanted to come up with something that could help cheer us up if we do start having a tough time and stuff.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That's what I want this song to convey...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Thank you, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Thanks, Saki...!
It really is a wonderful song.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hehe♪
I'm so glad that we managed to finish it!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(That's the message Saki wants to send...
My lyrics need to reflect that as well.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: How lost I may be doesn't matter, I know everything will be...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
N-No, that's a little too direct.
That's more like how I feel instead of what Saki wants to convey...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Something more roundabout might actually be better in this case...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I could throw in that here...
Oh, and this rhymes perfectly.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: This might actually sound really cool when we put it all together.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ichi, good morning!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Wah! S-Saki...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hm? Whatcha writing?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, just some lyrics.
But they're still a work in progress...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Wait, you are?!
Lemme see♪
se_event_future_2021_001

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: W-Wait, Saki!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hmm...
Lost. So lost in total sadness,
but being with you is true happiness...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Whoa, Ichi, this is so you!
I love it!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: B-But it's still a work in progress!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
No, this is awesome♪
I wanna keep reading!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You two seem awfully excited this morning. Did something happen?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Haruka, good morning!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Saki won't give me back my notebook...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Your notebook?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! Ichi was writing lyrics just now for this song I wrote!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, Tenma, you can write your own music...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Well, my band, Leo/need, you know♪

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That's incredible. And you're writing the lyrics, Hoshino?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Y-Yes. They're still a work in progress so I'm not really ready to show them to anyone yet, but Saki...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But I really wanted to see what you came up with♪

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. I fully understand how you feel right now, Hoshino...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: When it comes to singing and dancing, I'd rather have people see the finished product as opposed to something that I'm still practicing.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Really? You go through that too, Haruka?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes. Well, that's just me. I know some who have no problem showing others their own processes...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But Hoshino's trying to reach a certain level of completeness, right? So it may be best to give her a little more time.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Would you mind giving back her notebook, Tenma?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: O-Okay...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I-Ichi, I'm so sorry!
I'll be looking forward to seeing what you come up with!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Saki...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thanks, both of you. I promise to write something that'll do your song justice.
After school
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 1-C

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: *Sigh*...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I was hoping to finish writing my lyrics by today's practice, but that didn't really go as planned...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Our show's coming up too.
If I don't get my act together, we won't have enough time to practice...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(I just don't understand.
No matter how many times I try, I can't seem to find the right words for this...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (When I first heard Saki's song, I thought I knew what I wanted to write...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (But how do I put those thoughts into words...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Ichi!
Wanna head to practice?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, uh... Sure!
bgm_area00001
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Hi, everyone!
You seem good, Shihoppy♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You want to see how I react, don't you, Rin...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I have no idea what you're talking about.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Miku, would you mind helping us with practice again?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Of course.
Are you practicing for your next show?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes, there's that and...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We still need to practice our song.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, the one you finished the other day?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah♪
I've been so excited about finally getting to play it as a band!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Me too.
I'm sure you all pretty much know it by heart now, but we still need to polish it up for our show.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Did you bring your lyrics, Ichika?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Um, about that...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ichi, what's wrong?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm sorry, they're still not done yet.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, okay.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm sorry for making you rush like this. You still have plenty of time.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
No, I'm the one holding you all up.
I'll keep doing what I can to actually finish them.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Anyway, shall we get started with practice? We can start with Miku's songs that are gonna be in our show...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Oh, wait!
Can you hang on just one second?!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hm? Is something the matter?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Actually, I have some special news that's gonna knock your socks off!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Special news?! Tell us! Tell us!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Okay, here it goes...!
We have a really cool new addition to our group!
I can take it from here, Rin...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: KAITO...?!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hello...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I wasn't sure what you mean by special news at first but...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
This is so amazing!
It's KAITO! Like, the real deal!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, this is pretty big news.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You didn't have to go that far, Rin...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hey, you wouldn't have come out of your hidey hole if I didn't!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You sounded so eager to meet them yesterday too! But lo and behold, you were too scared to actually meet them!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: And the worst part is how you tried to slyly walk in after the girls had left! Isn't it fair to say you were gonna do the same thing today?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I mean...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I'm with Rin on this one. To be honest, I would've forced you out of hiding if she didn't do what she just did.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Right. This is all on you, KAITO.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Um... If now isn't a good time, we can wait until later to properly introduce ourselves to each other...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh, it's nothing like that.
He's just shy is all.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Shy...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. Yes, very.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: However, he's also very good at what he does. It's as if he can converse through music.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yeah☆
He really knows how to create a great atmosphere during performances!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: He's taught me so much already!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Then, would like to stay and watch us practice?

rows.Speaker: Saki & Honami
rows.Line: Please!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Sure...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, why don't we all greet each other by playing something together?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Wait, right now?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah! I'm totally for that!
I really wanna hear what KAITO's like when he plays!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: If he really can converse through music, I'd like to hear that as well.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, me too.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Me as well...!
That is, if you're both okay with that, Miku, KAITO.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: What do you think, KAITO?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Okay, I'll do it...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Okay, here we go!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh wow...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I wasn't expecting anything like this...!)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
(So powerful...!
It's like I'm being pulled into the song...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (It's not like he's just showing off either. He's playing so that his sound compliments everybody else's, but he still has this incredible presence...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Also...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (It almost feels like the music is somehow alive... As if he's trying to tell us something.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (This sound...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Is this what they meant by conversing through music...?)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
You really are something else, KAITO.
Can you tell us what was going through your mind while you were playing that?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I wanted you all to see a new door opening in front of you...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: A new door...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Does that mean you were trying to cheer us on?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, it certainly did have that feel to it.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah. The way he played went so well with how everyone else was playing too. I'd love to learn how to do that.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Me too...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thank you very much for that, KAITO!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I need to finish writing those lyrics if we're going to fully open that door KAITO just showed us...)
School SEKAI
se_event_future_2021_002

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, our song's coming along nicely...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That felt so good!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, that was so exciting...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We're still not quite at your guys' level, Miku, but that did sound pretty good.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah. We're improving so fast probably because we have such a vested interest in it as well.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Especially considering how much editing went into it. As tough as that was, it was totally worth the effort.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. It's all thanks to Shiho's incredible attention to detail.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I mean, it's sort of like Saki's baby, so I wanted to take good care of it.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Shiho...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Anyway, we should be ready to play this during our show as long as we keep it up.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But that also leaves...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Right, the lyrics. I'm so sorry...
I'll keep trying as much as I can.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Don't worry, we still have time...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Is it giving you that much trouble, Ichika?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes, it kind of is...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I hope it's not because of how I wrote our song. I'd feel awful if that's what's causing your writer's block...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: No, it's nothing like that.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Your song sends a clear message that even if things aren't going great for us right now that it'll get better if we just keep trying.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I want my lyrics to match what you're trying to convey.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Um, Ichika?
How much have you actually written?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Well...
I have a full outline, but I'm still not happy with what I've come up with.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Would you mind if we had a look?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: B-But...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Yes, I see.
It may be better to share the load instead of carrying this weight all on your own.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah!
When I was writing that song, I got lots of advice from everyone else!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I really don't know anything about writing lyrics, so my advice might not be that great... But I want to help you, Ichi!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Saki...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'd like to help as well, Ichika.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Me too.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay, I understand...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Um, here it is...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Lost. So lost in total sadness,
but being with you is true happiness.
Someday, we'll find that rainbow...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, you wrote this the other day!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Wow... I didn't know you could write anything like this, Ichika.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. They're very current.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It's hard to understand what you're trying to say, but I get what you're trying to do...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I knew it...
That's the problem.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
It never felt quite right.
These lyrics just don't do Saki's song justice and I don't know how to express her message...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: How to express her message, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, there's more on the previous page...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, look at that! Hm?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Wait, that's...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
How lost I may be doesn't matter,
I know everything will be all right
as long as we're together...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, that's so sweet...!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes, it captures the kindness in Ichika's heart so well.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I think I really like this one!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: N-No, we can't use that...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Why not?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Because it's so direct...
It also makes it seem like I put far too much of my own feelings into these lyrics...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Okay...?
What's wrong with that?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You're the one writing these, so I don't see any problems with you doing that.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Sure, that may be true but...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, I think I like these lyrics more, you know?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Me too. However, if you're still not satisfied with what you have, you may yet find a better way to express what you're trying to say.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Again, I'm so sorry...
I'll keep trying.
The next day
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Courtyard

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, Honami?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Her eyes are completely locked in on her phone... What could she be doing?)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hi, Honami.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Eep! H-Hi, Shiho...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Sorry, I didn't mean to startle you.
I was just wondering what you were doing.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, this...?
I was just listening to a STANDOUT song.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: STANDOUT? Why?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Remember how we discussed Ichika's lyrics yesterday?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I was ready to help her by giving whatever advice I could, but in the end, I couldn't since I just don't know enough about writing lyrics...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But I still want to help Ichika. That's why I'm trying to learn as much as I can right now by listening to some music.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: However, it hasn't gotten any easier...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: The lyrics Ichika first showed us were nice and all...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But I still like the ones where she just wore her heart on her sleeve much more...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yet STANDOUT's lyrics are so modern and work with their music so well.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It's so strange how similar lyrics can be presented so differently. I just can't seem to grasp how that happens...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Because there's no right answer when it comes to music...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Some people don't mince words while others can take a much more scenic route.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: The main problem is... What does Ichika want to say and how does she want to express that?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But I have no experience writing lyrics, so I doubt that I'll be able to give her any good advice...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: That's the worst part...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
I couldn't help Saki at all either...
Songwriting's the cornerstone of any band, but I can't contribute to that in any way.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Shiho...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Isn't there anything we can do for her...?
The next day
Live House

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line:
I see.
How to write lyrics, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yes. I was hoping that you'd know something since you've seen so many bands come through here.

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: I understand. However, Hinomori, just as you say, each band has their own style, so there really is no such thing as a right answer.

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: My impression is that you should let your friend work through her process until she finds something that rings true with her.

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: To be fair, I've never done anything like that before, so I'm probably not the best person to ask.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I guess there really isn't much we can do for her...

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Hi, about our next show...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line:
Oh, Hinomori?
I didn't know you were working today.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: And this is...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, this is Mochizuki, the drummer for Leo/need. It's been a little while.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Nice to meet you, Mochizuki.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line:
But did something happen?
You all seem really concerned.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It's nothing that serious.

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: Wait, Hinomori, why don't you ask Iori for some advice...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: She's the lyricist for STANDOUT, so this might be an incredible opportunity for you and your band.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Sorry, hang on. What's this about exactly?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I-If you'll let me...!
We're actually in the middle of composing our own song, but our friend is having some trouble writing lyrics for it...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We've been trying to find ways to help her by listening to songs by other bands and such, but we haven't been able to find a good solution...

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Oh, okay. Writing lyrics for a song, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
And...!
Would you mind if we asked you for some advice regarding this...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: There must be something that we're just not seeing, so we're wondering if you could help us, Ms. Iori...

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Yeah, I'd love to help but...

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: I don't know what's on your friend's mind or what she's going through, so nothing I say will probably end up helping.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
So, when's our next one gonna be?
I can't wait to do another one!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Hold your horses, Saki.
Let's talk about how today's show went first.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Aww, come one!
Can't we celebrate just a little bit...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: No. We need to discuss everything while it's still fresh in our heads.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: No, Shihooo...! You're like one of those really mean drill sergeants from the movies...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You could just stop coming to practice, you know?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Th-That was a joke! I was joking, okay?! I promise to keep practicing! I'm sorry!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. And we'll be right there with you, Saki. Let's keep doing what we can for us and our next show, okay?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah, you're right!
Hehe. Our next show...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Still, I have to think that people are starting to warm up to us. Especially considering how small our audience was today...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: This is pretty par for the course...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It's beyond rare to see anyone have any interest in a band that literally no one's ever heard of.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
But some of them got really into it!
I even heard a couple of them say that they really liked what we played!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. So did I!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah. Not many people were here to actually hear us play our song, but we definitely reached some of them.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: As long as we keep at it, that number will keep increasing. So let's keep trying our best.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah!
We took a big first step as Leo/need today.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (It wasn't exactly a great success or anything...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (But I'm so glad that we actually managed to get through to some people...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (This feeling...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ichi, what's wrong?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Well, it's just...
I was thinking about how I could turn how I feel right now into lyrics.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
You're ready to write another song?
I'd love to read what you come up with!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Me too! Me too!
How you feel right now means...
It's gonna be a super happy song, right♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We'll see once I get a chance to put pen to paper.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I'm able to express how I truly feel without holding back because I have them here with me.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Because of what we did today as Leo/need. Because we're together.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (It's okay for me to feel confident about what I write... Now, I know that.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ichi?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Uh, it's nothing.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm just hoping that we get to keep playing our own music like this.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, I hope so too...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Then, once we're done with this debrief, shall we start discussing our next song?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Let's think up some music that goes perfectly with Ichi's lyrics!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'll make sure to contribute to the next one.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: And we'll be looking forward to seeing what you come up with, Ichika.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So am I...!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Phew! We're doing great today too☆

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Especially, you, KAITO. I can't put my finger on it, but something seems different about the way you're playing.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
It's like...
You're really happy!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, I sensed that too. Almost as if each note is jumping for joy.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Did something good happen?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Well, I suppose so...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I have a feeling that the girls were finally able to step through that door.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I see. That means we have to keep doing what we can too.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. We're not about to let them leave us behind, are we?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: No way! We need to keep doing everything we can as their seniors.

rows.Speaker: Miku
